contract: Every syntax feature and registered element has generated grammar-certified inputs; every specification section explicitly names its source-grammar certificates or explains why it introduces no grammar obligation. Parser correctness is owned by parity and regression suites. Whole-language proofs apply only to the declared grammars; local boundaries do not certify their residual host grammar.

disposition.reason: A heading that declares no anchor is plain heading grammar, which the headings certificates cover; the parser derives no anchor from it.
A link to a heading is an ordinary inline link whose destination is the anchor; links-and-images certificates cover that form.
Anchor ownership and application matching are output/resolution contracts. Authored forms are covered by the explicit anchor sections and attribute-reference.
